title: armeria arctica var. californica
intro: Armeria arctica var. californica, commonly known as Western Thimbleflower, is a perennial plant species in the family Plumbaginaceae. It is a flowering plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Western Thimbleflower are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
